title: The Socio-Technical Staff+ Engineer: Architecture, Culture and Organisational Change
gist: In a QCon London talk, Vanessa Formicola argues staff-plus engineers fail through 'wishful design' that ignores organizational soil (reward systems, culture, leadership, maturity) and external climate (pandemics, geopolitics, digital sovereignty, ethics, AI). She proposes 'holistic engineering' in which senior technologists design the conditions for technology to thrive, emphasizing uniquely human skills like reframing problems and reading weak signals.
